security_justification.audit_integrity: Refuses invented committed state for non-success events; commit disposition must come from actual sanctioned operation evidence.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Authorization evaluation is unchanged. Denial remains an explicit outcome and does not alone establish a transaction commit state.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Preserves same-instance SDK-issued operation authority and existing branded context; no caller object or snapshot is upgraded to evidence.
security_justification.concurrency: No concurrency or reservation behavior changes; refusal occurs before sink use and existing operation transitions remain intact.
security_justification.confidentiality: No additional input fields, sinks or disclosure channels are introduced. The refusal contains only fixed diagnostic values.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitive, identifier generation or host capability changes. The correction uses existing operation evidence.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Uses only PREMATURE_SUCCESS, validation and /operation/state; no caller data or exception payload is exposed.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security integration changes. Node changes only its diagnostic documentation, not runtime durability or authority.
security_justification.fail_posture: Strengthens fail-closed behavior by refusing every transaction-bound outcome when operation evidence and direct state are absent.
security_justification.lifecycle: Preserves all sanctioned handle transitions and pending-success checks; removes only the unsupported handle-less terminal-state fallback.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Caller input and handles retain existing ownership. No mutation or copy can create evidence through the changed fallback.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No privacy or sanitization policy changes; existing event construction and sink privacy guards remain byte-identical.
security_justification.resource_retention: No retention capacities, histories or allocation policy changes. The refusal does not add stored context or new resources.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Complete-event emit and redeliver behavior remains out of scope; existing identity and retry semantics are unchanged.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Commit state continues to cross the operation boundary only through SDK-issued evidence; outcome alone is not authoritative transaction proof.
